## Product Tiers

- **Apex Core Foundation** ($229/mo): Dockerized n8n automation engine, local Ollama LLM runner, 3 custom workflow automations, 1 Legacy Data Bridge agent, Cloudflare Tunnel (outbound only), basic health monitoring, 30 days onboarding support
- **Apex Core Fleet** ($299/mo): Everything in Foundation plus unlimited workflow automations, 3 Legacy Data Bridge agents, fleet wide workflow sync and deploy, 24/7 AI voice and SMS intake engine, BigQuery and Looker Studio dashboards, up to 2 machines, 30 days onboarding support

## Trust and Confidentiality

- Every deployment operates inside the client's private infrastructure behind their firewall on their hardware
- All tunnel traffic is encrypted end to end via Cloudflare Zero Trust architecture
- Zero inbound ports architecture
- Mutual NDA required on every engagement
- We do not name clients publish logos or ask for testimonials
